verdict.rationale: Whether a SaaS invoicing product's source is available under an open license is a fair question, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence shows Stripe Invoicing's source is published or openly licensed. The mention of official API client libraries is a developer building block, not the product's own source, and no license is stated.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
